blocks.text: Alveoli mein oxygen ka partial pressure (hawa ke kul pressure mein oxygen ka hissa) oxygen ko alveoli se pulmonary capillaries mein diffuse hone deta hai. Khoon mein thodi si oxygen plasma mein ghul jati hai. Plasma zyada se zyada taqreeban 3 mL O₂ fi litre ghol sakta hai, magar poora khoon taqreeban 200 mL O₂ fi litre le jata hai! Wajah yeh hai ke zyada tar oxygen plasma mein ghuli nahi hoti balke RBCs ke andar haemoglobin ke molecules se judi hoti hai.

blocks.title: Naliyan surkh aur neeli kyun dikhai jati hain
blocks.text: Oxyhaemoglobin (oxygen wala haemoglobin) chamakdar surkh aur deoxyhaemoglobin (oxygen ke baghair) gehra surkh hota hai, magar deoxyhaemoglobin tissues ko halka neela rang deta hai. Isi liye diagrams mein oxygen wala khoon le jane wali naliyan surkh aur oxygen se khali khoon wali naliyan neeli dikhai jati hain.

Samundar ki satah par alveoli mein oxygen ka partial pressure taqreeban 105 mm Hg hai, jo bahar ki hawa se kam hai. Phir bhi RBCs ka taqreeban 97% haemoglobin oxygen se jud kar oxyhaemoglobin ban jata hai, jis ka rang tamatar ke juice jaisa chamakdar surkh hai. Khoon capillaries se guzarta hai to kuch oxyhaemoglobin oxygen chhod kar gehre surkh rang ka deoxyhaemoglobin ban jata hai. Is liye jab khoon tissue se veins mein nikalta hai to us mein oxygen ka partial pressure kam (40 mm Hg) hota hai. Yahan 75% haemoglobin abhi bhi oxyhaemoglobin hota hai. Yani 22% (97% − 75%) oxyhaemoglobin ne apni oxygen tissues ko de di, aur 75% oxyhaemoglobin khoon mein zakheere (reserve) ke tor par bacha rehta hai. Yeh bada zakheera aaram aur warzish (exercise) dono mein jism ki oxygen ki zaroorat poori karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke “78% oxyhaemoglobin” zakheere mein bachta hai. Kitab ke apne adad se 97% − 22% = 75% banta hai, yani zakheera 75% hai, 78% nahi.
Oxygen ke transport par asar dalne wali cheezein

Warzish mein muscles capillaries ke khoon se zyada oxygen le leti hain. Is se veins ke khoon mein oxygen ka partial pressure 20 mm Hg tak gir jata hai, aur haemoglobin ki saturation (oxygen se bhara hona) 75% se 35% par aa jati hai. Arteries ke khoon mein ab bhi 97% oxyhaemoglobin hai, is liye ab 62% (97% − 35%) oxygen tissues ko milti hai, aaram ke 22% ke bajaye.

blocks.title: Zakheere ka faida
blocks.text: Oxygen ke is zakheere ki wajah se agar saans ruk jaye ya dil pump karna band kar de to bhi khoon mein chaar se paanch minute tak zindagi ke liye kaafi oxygen hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Teen pattiyan jo haemoglobin ki oxygen se sairi (saturation) dikhati hain: arterial khoon, PO2 105 mm Hg par 97%; aaram mein venous khoon, PO2 40 mm Hg par 75% (22% utri); warzish mein venous khoon, PO2 20 mm Hg par 35% (62% utri). Neeche 0 se 100% ka paimana hai.
blocks.caption: Mukhtalif PO2 par haemoglobin ki oxygen se sairi (matn ke aadad se asal chart; kitab mein yahan koi figure nahin).

blocks.text: Tissues ki banai hui CO₂ khoon ka pH kam karti hai (khoon thoda tezabi hota hai). Kam pH par haemoglobin ki oxygen se affinity (pakad) kam ho jati hai, is liye woh oxygen aasani se chhod deta hai. pH ke is asar ko Bohr effect kehte hain. Temperature barhne ka bhi yahi asar hai. Warzish mein skeletal muscles zyada garmi banati hain, is liye haemoglobin zyada oxygen chhodta hai.
